lines.cap: For decades, people saw strange lights over Area 51. In 2013, the CIA finally admitted what they were.
lines.say: For decades, people saw strange lights over Area 51. In 2013, the CIA finally admitted what they were.

lines.cap: Area 51. A secret air base in the Nevada desert. For years, the US government wouldn't even say it existed.
lines.say: Area 51. A secret air base in the Nevada desert. For years, the US government wouldn't even say it existed.

lines.cap: Pilots and locals reported silver objects flying impossibly high. Higher than any plane could go.
lines.say: Pilots and locals reported silver objects flying impossibly high. Higher than any plane could go.

lines.cap: In 2013, the CIA released files. The lights were U-2 spy planes, flying at seventy thousand feet. Most planes flew at twenty.
lines.say: In 2013, the CIA released files. The lights were U-2 spy planes, flying at seventy thousand feet. Most planes flew at twenty.

lines.cap: Over half the UFO reports back then were secret spy planes. The Air Force knew, and let people blame aliens.
lines.say: Over half the UFO reports back then were secret spy planes. The Air Force knew, and let people blame aliens.

lines.cap: In 1989, a man went on TV claiming he'd worked on alien spaceships there. No proof was ever found.
lines.say: In 1989, a man went on TV claiming he'd worked on alien spaceships there. No proof was ever found.

lines.cap: In 2019, two million people signed up online to storm Area 51. About a hundred and fifty actually showed up. Mostly to party.
lines.say: In 2019, two million people signed up online to storm Area 51. About a hundred and fifty actually showed up. Mostly to party.
